title: Cross-country one-nighters and booking by MCA
summary: Touring with Red's band, booked by MCA's Willard Alexander.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you go cross country with that band?
Sure, up and down, cross country. I did it with Benny too.

MCA. Willard Alexander was with MCA at that time. That period is when we went to Chicago, took another flyer at studying music. For me it was a digression, very important. Before that we had begun making records. I guess they're the same size as a 33 now; they used to be small.
And they would have boxes with about five or six of them?
